column1: These measurements should be collected 2x per week alongside photos.
the actual date that the measurements were taken (YYYY-MM-DD)
column2: the ID number of the monolith, between 1 and 21
column3: the functional group being measured, one of "forb", "shrub", or "graminoid"
column4:
Seperate the plant into 4 quadrants, based on the N-S-E-W stickers. Measure the height of the tallest part of each plant functional type in each quadrant using a measuring tape in cm
Letters refer to the quadrant of the plant. NE refers to the quadrant spanning from the north sticker to the east sticker, for example.
column12: Measure the length of three leaves from each functional group using a measuring tape in cm. These leaves should be marked with a toothpick or other marker, so we can make sure we are measuring the same leaf each week.
column15: Count the number of unopened buds visible in the pot (Not by functional group)
column16: Count the number of fully open flowers in the pot (Not by functional group)
column17: Count the number of wilted, brown or dropping flowers (Not by functional group)
column18:
Estimate % of canopy leaves displaying autumnal color changes
(Not by functional group)
column19: Note any observations like big changes ((ex. first green leaves visible, first open flower observed in pot, first observed yellowing), notable things (ex. any particularly tall flowers, seeds dropping)
